articles.summary: Fastenal Company (Nasdaq:FAST) ('Fastenal,' 'we,' 'our,' or 'us') reported its board of directors declared a dividend of $0.26 per share to be paid in cash on November 25, 2026 to shareholders of record at the close of business on October 28, 2026. Except for share and per share information, dollar amounts are stated in millions.
